entities.summary: Mohammad Nizar bin Jamaluddin is a Malaysian politician and engineer who has served as a member of the Perak State Executive Council since November 2022 under Saarani Mohamad and from May 2018 to March 2020 under Ahmad Faizal Azumu, and as a member of the Perak State Legislative Assembly for Sungai Rapat since May 2018. He previously served as the 10th Menteri Besar of Perak from March 2008 to the collapse of his administration in February 2009, represented Changkat Jering from May 2013 to May 2018 and Pasir Panjang from March 2008 to May 2013 in the legislative assembly, and represented Bukit Gantang in the Dewan Rakyat from April 2009 to May 2013.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As the 10th Menteri Besar of Perak from March 2008 to February 2009, Mohammad Nizar Jamaluddin played a significant role in shaping the state's politics during a period of significant social and economic change. His tenure was marked by controversy and ultimately led to his administration's collapse.
